blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A lawmaker has asked his colleagues in the House to approve a measure that would grant health insurance to workers in the informal economy, to ensure that they will have a financial safety net during unanticipated health crises. In a statement on Tuesday, Quezon City Rep. Patrick Michael Vargas said he has filed House Bill (HB) No. 11028 or the proposed Informal Workers Health Benefits and Insurance Act, which seeks to address the health insurance coverage needs of informal sector workers like public utility drivers, delivery riders, street vendors, and other frontline workers. “Madaming Pilipino ang pinipiling pumasok […]...
